chapterInfo.content:
14
Wɔnam ntontotwe so ma mmusuakuo nkron ne fa no agyapadeɛ
1 # Num 34.17 Na yei ne Israel agyapadeɛ a wɔnyaa no Kanaan asase soɔ a Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne Nun ba Yosua ne Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo mu agyanom so atitire no kyekyɛ maa wɔn, 2#Num 26.55 wɔn agyapadeɛ a ɛnam ntontotwe soɔ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛɛ sɛ wɔmma mmusuakuo nkron ne fa no. 3#Yos 13.14-33 Na Mose ama mmusuakuo mmienu ne fa no agyapadeɛ wɔ Yordan agya, na Lewifoɔ deɛ, wamma wɔn agyapadeɛ biara wɔ wɔn mu. 4#Yos 21 Na Yosef mma yɛ mmusuakuo mmienu, Manase ne Efraim, na wɔamma Lewifoɔ no kyɛfa biara asase no so, gye nkuro a wɔbɛtena mu ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase ma wɔn mmoa ne wɔn nnoɔma. 5Sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no, saa na Israelfoɔ no yɛeɛ, na wɔkyɛɛ asase no mu.
Wɔde Hebron ma Kaleb
6 # Num 14.24; Deut 1.36 Na Yudafoɔ no baa Yosua nkyɛn wɔ Gilgal; na Kenesini Yefune ba Kaleb ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wo ara wonim me ne wo ho asɛm a AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn nipa Mose wɔ Kades-barnea. 7#Num 13.6, 30 Medii mfirinhyia aduanan na AWURADE akoa Mose somaa me firi Kades-barnea sɛ menkɔsra asase no, na mesane mede emu asɛm mebrɛɛ no, sɛdeɛ ɛwɔ m’akoma mu. 8Na me nuanom a wɔne me foro kɔeɛ no maa ɔman no akoma tui, na me deɛ, medii AWURADE me Nyankopɔn akyi mewiee. 9Na Mose kaa ntam da no ara sɛ: Asase a wo nan tiaa soɔ no bɛyɛ wo ne wo mma agyapadeɛ daa, ɛfiri sɛ woadi AWURADE me Nyankopɔn akyi awie. 10Na afei hwɛ, AWURADE ama matena ase sɛdeɛ ɔkaeɛ no, mfirinhyia aduanan nnum yi, ɛfiri berɛ a AWURADE kaa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ Mose berɛ a na Israel nam serɛ soɔ no. Na afei, hwɛ, ɛnnɛ madi mfirinhyia aduɔwɔtwe nnum. 11#Deut 34.7 Meda so mewɔ ahoɔden nnɛ yi ara, sɛ deɛ na meteɛ da a Mose somaa me no; sɛdeɛ m’ahoɔden teɛ da no, saa ara na ɛteɛ nnɛ ma ɔko ne adifire ne emuba. 12#Yos 11.21 Na afei, fa bepɔ yi a AWURADE kaa ho asɛm da no no ma me, ɛfiri sɛ da no ara wotee sɛ Anakfoɔ ne nkuro akɛseɛ a wɔatoto ho afasuo wɔ hɔ. Ebia AWURADE bɛdi m’akyi na matu wɔn, sɛdeɛ AWURADE kaeɛ no.
13 # Yos 15.13-19; 21.11-12 Na Yosua hyiraa no, na ɔde Hebron maa Yefune ba Kaleb sɛ n’agyapadeɛ. 14Ɛno nti na Hebron yɛɛ Kenesini Yefune ba Kaleb agyapadeɛ de bɛsi nnɛ da yi, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdii AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn no akyi yie. 15#Yos 11.23 Nso akane no na Hebron din ne Kiriat-arba. Arba yi ne Anakfoɔ mu nipa kɛseɛ koraa. Na asase no so dwo firii akodie mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na yei ne Israel agyapadeɛ a wɔnyaa no Kanaan asase soɔ a Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne Nun ba Yosua ne Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo mu agyanom so atitire no kyekyɛ maa wɔn, wɔn agyapadeɛ a ɛnam ntontotwe soɔ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛɛ sɛ wɔmma mmusuakuo nkron ne fa no. Na Mose ama mmusuakuo mmienu ne fa no agyapadeɛ wɔ Yordan agya, na Lewifoɔ deɛ, wamma wɔn agyapadeɛ biara wɔ wɔn mu. Na Yosef mma yɛ mmusuakuo mmienu, Manase ne Efraim, na wɔamma Lewifoɔ no kyɛfa biara asase no so, gye nkuro a wɔbɛtena mu ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase ma wɔn mmoa ne wɔn nnoɔma. Sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no, saa na Israelfoɔ no yɛeɛ, na wɔkyɛɛ asase no mu.

Na Yudafoɔ no baa Yosua nkyɛn wɔ Gilgal; na Kenesini Yefune ba Kaleb ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wo ara wonim me ne wo ho asɛm a AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn nipa Mose wɔ Kades-barnea. Medii mfirinhyia aduanan na AWURADE akoa Mose somaa me firi Kades-barnea sɛ menkɔsra asase no, na mesane mede emu asɛm mebrɛɛ no, sɛdeɛ ɛwɔ m’akoma mu. Na me nuanom a wɔne me foro kɔeɛ no maa ɔman no akoma tui, na me deɛ, medii AWURADE me Nyankopɔn akyi mewiee. Na Mose kaa ntam da no ara sɛ: Asase a wo nan tiaa soɔ no bɛyɛ wo ne wo mma agyapadeɛ daa, ɛfiri sɛ woadi AWURADE me Nyankopɔn akyi awie. Na afei hwɛ, AWURADE ama matena ase sɛdeɛ ɔkaeɛ no, mfirinhyia aduanan nnum yi, ɛfiri berɛ a AWURADE kaa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ Mose berɛ a na Israel nam serɛ soɔ no. Na afei, hwɛ, ɛnnɛ madi mfirinhyia aduɔwɔtwe nnum. Meda so mewɔ ahoɔden nnɛ yi ara, sɛ deɛ na meteɛ da a Mose somaa me no; sɛdeɛ m’ahoɔden teɛ da no, saa ara na ɛteɛ nnɛ ma ɔko ne adifire ne emuba. Na afei, fa bepɔ yi a AWURADE kaa ho asɛm da no no ma me, ɛfiri sɛ da no ara wotee sɛ Anakfoɔ ne nkuro akɛseɛ a wɔatoto ho afasuo wɔ hɔ. Ebia AWURADE bɛdi m’akyi na matu wɔn, sɛdeɛ AWURADE kaeɛ no.
Na Yosua hyiraa no, na ɔde Hebron maa Yefune ba Kaleb sɛ n’agyapadeɛ. Ɛno nti na Hebron yɛɛ Kenesini Yefune ba Kaleb agyapadeɛ de bɛsi nnɛ da yi, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdii AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn no akyi yie. Nso akane no na Hebron din ne Kiriat-arba. Arba yi ne Anakfoɔ mu nipa kɛseɛ koraa. Na asase no so dwo firii akodie mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
